newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU in "broad agreement" on new air liability rule. [CORRECTED 12:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EU in "broad agreement" on new air liability rule. [CORRECTED 12:50 GMT]

text.p: European Union transport ministers reached broad agreement on Friday on a fast-track system under which airlines would pay compensation to air travellers or their relatives in the event of crashes.

"The existing regime has long been in need of reform and updating and I will be pushing for final adoption of the new arrangements (in) December," Irish Transport Minister Michael Lowry said in a statement.
Ministers "broadly agreed" on the substance of a Commission proposal to review air liability rules said an Irish diplomat, whose country currently holds the EU presidency.
The proposal suggests making airlines strictly liable for 100,000 Ecus ($124,800) in the event of a crash, meaning they could not exclude or limit their liability for that sum by proving no fault.
The Commission said this would protect passengers in the event of terrorist attacks where, at present, there is no cover.
Carriers would also be required to pay out 50,000 Ecus compensation within 10 days of a passenger's death or up to a ceiling of 50,000 Ecus in the event of injury, it said.

If adopted, the rules would also allow crash victims or their dependents to pursue court action in their home courts rather than in the carrier's country of origin, its main place of business or at the beginning or end of the ticketed journey.
The proposal would abolish the current $10,000 ceiling on passenger liability in the event of injury or death in a crash and extend the liability cover to domestic flights in the 15-country bloc.
Existing rules, as defined under 1929 Warsaw Convention and other agreements, apply only to international flights.
Questions remained, however, on whether rules should apply to smaller EU carriers and to non-EU airlines carrying EU passengers.
Ministers also considered the immediate pay-out clause and the question of where legal action should take place, without reaching conclusions. ($1=.8012 Ecu)
